units.source_text: 随从者都惊醒了，大家深深感动，哀思难忍，

en.t: The attendants all woke in surprise, deeply moved and unable to bear their sorrow,

units.source_text: 不知不觉地坐起身来，偷偷地揩眼泪，擤鼻涕。

en.t: and before they knew it they sat up, secretly wiping their tears and blowing their noses.

units.source_text: 源氏公子听见了，想道：“此等人不知作何感想。

en.t: Prince Genji heard them and thought, "I wonder what these people must be feeling.

units.source_text: 他们都为了我一人之故，抛开了片刻不忍分离的骨肉，

en.t: For my sake alone, they have all left behind the family they could hardly bear to part from even for a moment,

units.source_text: 飘泊来此，生受此种苦楚。”

en.t: and have wandered here to suffer such hardship."
He felt deeply sorry toward them.

units.source_text: 心念今后如果长此愁叹，他们看了一定更加伤心。

en.t: He thought that if he continued grieving like this, they would surely be even more saddened to see it.

units.source_text: 于是强自振作起来，昼间和他们讲种种笑话，借以消愁遣怀。

en.t: So he forced himself to take heart, and during the day he told them all kinds of amusing stories to ease their melancholy.

units.source_text: 寂寞无聊之时，将各种色彩的纸黏合起来，作戏笔的书法；

en.t: When he was lonely and bored, he pasted together papers of many colors and idly practiced calligraphy;

units.source_text: 又在珍贵的中国绢上戏笔作画，贴在屏风上，画得非常美妙。

en.t: he also playfully painted on precious Chinese silk and mounted the paintings on screens, where they looked wonderfully beautiful.

units.source_text: 以前身居京都，听人描述高山大海的景色，只是遥遥地想象其姿态而已。

en.t: In the past, while living in Kyoto, he had only heard people describe the scenery of high mountains and the great sea, imagining their forms from afar.

units.source_text: 如今亲眼目睹，觉得真山真水之美，决非想象所能及，便作了许多优秀无比的图画。

en.t: Now that he saw them with his own eyes, he felt that the beauty of real mountains and waters far surpassed imagination, and he made many incomparable paintings.

units.source_text: 随从人等看了都说：“应该召请当今有名的画家千枝和常则来，

en.t: When the attendants saw them, they all said, "We should summon the famous painters of the day, Chie and Tsunenori,

units.source_text: 教他们替这些画着色才好。”

en.t: and have them add color to these paintings."
Everyone felt it was a great pity.

units.source_text: 他们接近这个亲切可爱的人物，便可忘却尘世之苦患。

en.t: By drawing near to this gracious and lovable person, they could forget the sufferings of the world.

units.source_text: 因此有四五个人时时随侍在侧，他们认为亲近公子乃一大乐事。

en.t: For this reason, four or five of them were always in attendance at his side, regarding closeness to the prince as a great joy.
